# crusoe_transport_partition (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crusoe_transport_networks" "example" {}

resource "crusoe_transport_partition" "example" {
  name                 = "my-transport-partition"
  transport_network_id = data.crusoe_transport_networks.example.transport_networks[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the InfiniBand partition.
- `transport_network_id` (String) ID of the InfiniBand network the partition belongs to.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the transport partition belongs to. If not specified, the project ID will be inferred from the Crusoe configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the InfiniBand partition.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Resources are imported by their ID. To target a specific project, append the
# project ID using the format "<id>,<project_id>".
terraform import crusoe_transport_partition.example <transport_partition_id>
```
